name: Taj Mahal
description: Shah Jahan's white marble tomb for Mumtaz Mahal in Agra, built in Blender from real photographs: the Great Gate, the charbagh garden and reflecting pools, the plinth and minarets, and the tomb chamber with its cenotaphs. Amanat the calligrapher, a Labubu guide, answers questions offline from a guidebook. Made by Ayush Rajpal.
